post.summary: Sign in with phone number and password
post.description: Sets the session cookie. Five failed attempts in 15 minutes delay access for 15 minutes (ER-03-05), even when the password is then correct. Attempts are counted per submitted phone number whether or not it is registered, and the delay answers 429 RATE_LIMITED, so the response never shows that a number exists. Belum Aktif and Nonaktif accounts get no session and the same 401 as a wrong password.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

401.description: Wrong phone number or password. The same answer for unknown numbers.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry-After says when to try again.

post.description: Ends the session of the cookie, if there is one. Always 204, so the frontend can call it without checking whether the session already expired.

post.summary: Change the password of the signed-in account
post.description: 8 to 128 characters, different from the current password, equal to the confirmation (ER-03-02). A wrong currentPassword is a 400 on that field and counts toward the login lockout. Success ends every session and OTP of the account, including this one, so the person signs in again. A failed validation changes nothing.

204.description: Password changed. All sessions ended; sign in again.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry-After says when to try again.

post.summary: Request an OTP by WhatsApp for activation, recovery or a number change
post.description: Answers 202 with the same body whether or not the number is registered and whether or not a code was made (DEC-05). The limits apply to every submitted number: 60 seconds between requests and 5 per number per hour, answered 429 with Retry-After. The code is six digits, valid 5 minutes, sent only to the number on the account. If the WhatsApp message cannot be sent the answer is still 202; the person asks again after the wait or uses the help contact on the landing page.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry-After says when to try again.

post.summary: Activate or recover an account with a valid OTP and set the password
post.description: Activation and recovery share this shape. A valid OTP ends all earlier sessions and OTPs. At most 5 wrong attempts per OTP, then the code is void. A password equal to the current one is a 400 on password and leaves the code usable. Wrong, expired, used and void codes all answer the same 401.

204.description: Password set. The user signs in next.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

401.description: The OTP is wrong, expired, or already used. One answer for all three.

post.summary: Prove a new phone number with its OTP
post.description: Staff enter the new number on the customer (POST /customers/{customerId}/phone-change). The person who holds the new number requests a code with purpose phoneChange and confirms it here. Only then does the login number change, and every session and OTP issued before it stops working (ER-05-04). Staff never see the code.

204.description: The number changed. Sign in with the new number.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

401.description: The OTP is wrong, expired, or already used.

put.summary: Activate or deactivate an account (Admin only)
put.description: Applies to staff and Client accounts. Deactivation ends the sessions and OTPs in the same transaction, even when a Teknisi still has active tickets (ER-04-05). The audit trail keeps who, when, why, and the status before and after. Reactivation returns the account to Aktif, or to Belum Aktif if it never set a password. Setting the status it already has answers 409 INVALID_STATE.

post.summary: Enter a new phone number for a customer (Admin or Officer)
post.description: Check the person's identity first, as company procedure says. If the account is Belum Aktif the number is corrected at once and earlier OTPs are void. If it is Aktif the login number does not change yet: the holder of the new number requests an OTP with purpose phoneChange and confirms it at /auth/phone-change/confirm, and only then do the number and all sessions change (ER-05-04). Staff never see the code. A Nonaktif account answers 409 INVALID_STATE. Services and tickets stay with the customer (ER-05-05).

put.summary: Upload or replace the KTP photo (Admin or Officer)
put.description: multipart/form-data with one `file`. JPEG or PNG judged by content, not name or Content-Type. At most 5 MiB and 8000 x 8000 pixels. The image is decoded and re-encoded, which removes GPS and other metadata. It is stored encrypted on a private volume. Replacing removes the earlier file. Errors: FILE_TOO_LARGE 413, FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED 415, FILE_CORRUPT 422 (empty or unreadable).

200.description: A retry. The stored ticket is returned.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

404.description: The record does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

409.description: The same key is still being processed.

422.description: The key was already used for different content.

501.description: Draft contract. The endpoint is not implemented yet.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: One key per logical submission. Retry a timeout with the same key and identical fields/files. New submissions or changed content use a new key; resolve an uncertain earlier submission first.

get.description: Cursor pagination, newest first. Visibility follows the caller's role.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

501.description: Draft contract. The endpoint is not implemented yet.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: a number between 1 and 100
